signals.text: Great fitting. Comfortable and easy to travel with.

I love the colors... they are bright.  The waist is about an 8" elastic band.  There is a tie for the front... or you could tie to the side.  The bottom is all different lengths, which I was hoping would be a little less uneven.  You can wear over your bust area like a dress or coverup.  There are several ways to wear as dress. I am 5'7" and when up like a dress, it still covered my knees. I like the style, but I am an old hippie gal.  I don't love rayon, but that is mostly what you get these da

This is an interesting skirt.  I hate my fat knees and it covers them.  I am just a huge fan of the material.  Super wrinkly.  There are pockets.  Not sure if I will keep it.  I am 5'7", usually wear a 14/16 or 0x/1x and the XL fits, but loosely.  I am a little worried about it slipping down after I put my cell phone in my pocket or ?
